messages:
anna_cs: FYI we got a vendor risk form from SolaceHealth — they ask for: 'Do you classify model inputs/embeddings as personal data? If yes, describe retention & deletion process.' Can we align on answer by EOW?

matt_sech: we should flag this for SOC2 scope too. My quick take: embeddings aren't stored with tenant ids in hosted — we persist anonymized vectors in S3 with tenant hash. I'll add proposed wording.

sasha_onboard: proposed answer (draft): "We treat raw inputs as PII where provided; embeddings are pseudonymized floats stored with a non-reversible tenant hash; retention defaults to 30 days for hosted trial, configurable for enterprise via contract and BYOK/KMS. Deletion requests are supported via API and audited." Thoughts?

ben_engineering: sounds right. Need to confirm where audit logs live and who owns deletion job. @infra-ops?

privacy-bot: [automated] SOC2 evidence pointer: control CC-6: data retention policy — doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/soc2/data-retention-v2 (access limited). Pull request for deletion pipeline tracked: ENG-4523.

anna_cs: ok assigning: @sasha_onboard update draft with specific S3 path and description of KMS key policy; @ben_engineering owner for deletion job confirmation; @matt_sech check SOC2 pointer + add control mapping table. Target: deliver final text + attach to vendor form by Thu 18:00 PT. :calendar:

sasha_onboard: will update. attaching sample snippet for how we describe storage:

```
Storage: s3://redwood-hosted/embeddings/anonymized/ (no tenant_id),
Encryption: AES256 + customer-managed KMS (enterprise only),
Retention policy: lifecycle rule 30d -> transition/expire
```

matt_sech: also flag renewal risk: customer is mid-trial with renewal decision in 6 weeks; if vendor deems retention non-compliant we might need legal addendum quick. recommend CS ops triage call with legal tomorrow. @legal-team?

anna_cs: noted. I'll schedule 30-min window tomorrow 10am PT. If anyone cannot make, ping here. Thanks all :pray:
